known_edge_cases: Mirrors: full-length mirror in bedroom B2, small wall mirror over the hall wash basin (reflection handling)
Glossy reflective floor tiles in the hall
Hall/kitchen is an open-plan irregular quadrilateral, not a rectangle - do not assume 90-degree corners without a diagonal check
Bathroom is L-shaped, not a rectangle
Real ceiling crack in bathroom (naturally occurring, unmeasured)
Hall photos and videos captured in the evening under artificial light
measurement_caveats: Door width convention: width is the clear opening between the inner frame edges (the gap a depth sensor sees in the wall) and width_outer is frame edge to frame edge; the balcony door and the windows are measured end to end only. Doors b1_door, b2_door and bathroom_door were remeasured on 2026-09-20 (earlier single values 94, 94 and 79.4 cm are replaced)
Doors appear under the same id in each room they connect (b1_door, b2_door, bathroom_door); count each id once for opening scoring - 9 unique openings in total
B1 & B2 windows: measured once, same value applied to both rooms - not independently verified per window
Hall diagonal not measured - 4 side lengths alone do not uniquely constrain the quadrilateral's true shape/angles
Photos captured at 0.8x zoom (ultra-wide lens), video at 0.6x zoom - both have more lens distortion than the main lens; not corrected for in raw ground truth, must be handled in pipeline calibration
